Elias glanced past the foaming breakers toward the horizon, wondering how many ships had passed blindly over the hazard while this warning drifted silently in the dark.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市尚未苏醒，整座钢筋森林浸泡在冷冽的深蓝之中。街灯泛着昏黄而困倦的光芒，将环卫工人的扫帚声拉得极长。偶有一辆冷链货车划破空旷的主干道，引擎声迅速被浓重的夜色吞没。便利店的白光如同一座孤岛，收银员托腮打盹，等待着第一班早班地铁唤醒晨曦。", "w03": "• It is like opening a Russian nesting doll and finding a smaller version of the exact same doll inside.\n• You keep repeating the exact same action on the smaller problem until you reach the tiniest piece that cannot be split.\n• Once you hit that final stop, you pass the answers back up the chain to solve the whole thing."}
